title: Hearty Smoked British Smoked Salmon Cottage Pie
description: A winey and crumbly one-pot British dish featuring smoked salmon, this cottage pie is perfect for a comforting meal, with a rich braise and raw-friendly ingredients, all in one form of a classic cottage pie.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a large pan, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the onion and carrots until softened.
Add the chopped smoked salmon and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the red wine and beef broth to the pan and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a separate pot, boil the chopped potatoes until tender, then drain and mash with butter and flour.
Transfer the salmon mixture to a baking dish and top with the mashed potatoes and grated cheese.
Bake the cottage pie in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
